INSPECTION COMPLIANCE REPORT
Office of the District Collector & District Magistrate, Kota
Date: 4 July 2025 (Ref No: RAJ/211)
Subject: Digital Financial Literacy and Micro-Enterprise Training for Women SHGs (Phase-4)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Kota division are hereby informed that under 'Digital Financial Literacy and Micro-Enterprise Training for Women SHGs', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 9 July in the central branches wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #311) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Kota, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and branches movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Kota), 2. Budget Reconciliation #121, 3. Digital Indexing.
Nodal Officer (Audit)
Neeraj Kumar Verma
solution_steps: 2. Click Center align, Bold, and Shading.
